artworks.title: Composition
artworks.medium: linocut in black on laid paper

artworks.title: Bridge
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image displays a collection of bold, angular, and curved shapes woven into a complex pattern. The dark and light contrasts create shapes resembling a bridge over water, with strands resembling grass or reeds. The interlocking forms evoke a landscape with a bridge, houses with triangular rooftops, and vertical lines resembling tall plants.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Sun
artworks.description: The image consists of bold, angular lines and shapes against a vibrant background. Thick black outlines create geometric forms resembling sails or flags. The composition features contrasting colors, including a warm orange background and cool blues and reds in the foreground.

artworks.title: Stylized Sailboats
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image depicts sharp, angular shapes and lines arranged in a pattern that forms an abstract composition. Dark triangular and rectangular forms contrast with lighter spaces, creating a fragmented design resembling a city skyline or jagged mountain peaks. The arrangement suggests connections to natural and urban landscapes, with elements resembling tall structures and converging lines akin to architectural forms or geological features.

artworks.title: Composition XXII
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays jagged and curvilinear black shapes on a light background. The abstract composition resembles a chaotic tangle of lines and forms. The negative space between the shapes forms irregular patterns.

artworks.title: Blühende Spireen (Blooming Spiraea)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.description: The image displays a scene from a low elevation, showing a bridge with two figures sitting atop. Detailed plants with feathery leaves are in the foreground, casting shadows on the stone bridge. The background features dense foliage with intricate line work, creating a monochromatic color palette of browns and blacks. The composition lacks a visible horizon, filled with vegetation and structures.

artworks.title: November
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows elongated, curved lines creating an abstract representation of a pathway. Silhouetted figures walk along this path, some carrying umbrellas. In the background, there is a structure with posters and advertisements. The abstracted shadows and elongated shapes convey depth and movement.

artworks.title: Small World
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex tapestry of interwoven lines and abstract shapes, featuring circles, triangles, and jagged forms. Abstract figures resembling eyes and mask-like faces are dispersed throughout the composition. The artwork showcases a dense layering of patterns and a play of dark and light areas, creating a textured effect.

artworks.title: A Standing Nude
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching on japan paper
artworks.description: The image displays a nude figure, captured from the upper thighs up. The person's body is slightly turned to the side, with their head tilted down. They have short, dark hair that partially obscures their forehead. The facial features are soft, with closed eyes. One arm is bent with the hand resting on their chest, while the other arm hangs down the side of the body. The background is a dark, textured surface that contrasts with the highlighted tones of the figure. No clothing, jewelry, or objects are present.

artworks.title: Erinnerung (Memory)
artworks.medium: etching and mezzotint on wove cream paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person shown from the upper torso upward. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side but facing forward, with their head framed between two vertical dark shapes. Their facial features include a contemplative expression with downcast eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. The person has short, dark hair that is styled close to the head with a slight wave. They are wearing a garment that appears to have a subtle texture. The background features a softly rendered outdoor scene with trees and foliage. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held.

artworks.title: Sibylle (Sibyl)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a woman seated on a stone bench, with most of her body visible from the head down to her feet, which are partially covered by draped fabric. She is in a seated position, leaning slightly to her left, with her left hand resting on a stack of books, holding a writing instrument, while her right hand is lightly touching her chest. Her facial features are calm and composed, with slightly parted lips and eyes gazing upwards. She has long hair covered by a headscarf or veil that falls over her shoulders, while wearing a classic draped garment, resembling a gown. The background features a stone wall and possibly an ancient interior with arched niches or openings on the left side. The entire scene is rendered in a monochromatic style, highlighting the textures and shadows of the setting.

artworks.title: München (Munich)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with fields leading to a city skyline in the distance. The horizon is low, displaying city buildings with spires and towers. The detailed etching technique uses fine lines to depict figures and elements. The monochromatic color palette includes black, white, and shading for textures. In the foreground, figures are farming with haystacks and a cart. More figures are dispersed in the fields, leading to the city background under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: A Large Oak Tree in Gehölz. A Young Man with a Spear Follows a Young Girl.
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching featuring a scene beneath a large tree. The tree's canopy occupies most of the composition, with detailed foliage depicted through fine lines. The perspective is slightly below eye level, and two human figures are near the tree's base, engaged in a dynamic interaction. In the background, other trees are suggested, creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: A Widely Expanding Oak Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a large, ancient tree with twisting branches and dense foliage. In the background, smaller trees and a trail of land create depth. The artwork depicts intricate line work to show texture and detail. The color scheme is black and gray, enhancing the detailed quality. A figure with a hat and staff walks near the tree, providing a sense of scale and human interaction with nature.

artworks.title: A Dead Oak Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a gnarled tree with twisted branches and a textured trunk. The horizon is low in the frame, with more trees visible in the distance. The brushstrokes are precise and detailed, capturing the texture of the tree. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. The ground is scattered with plants and leaves, and there is a figure sitting by the tree.

artworks.title: Foliage Study with Reed and Hops
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of large leaves and plants in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of shades of black and white. Large leaves with curled edges are visible, with varying shades of shading and textures. The leaves overlap each other, stretching upward and outward. Smaller clusters of foliage and delicate fronds can be seen behind and around the larger leaves.

artworks.title: Foliage with Reeds
artworks.description: The image features large, deeply veined and detailed leaves in black and white. The leaves dominate the central and lower foreground, with taller stems and slender leaves reaching towards the upper half. In the upper right, a cluster of smaller leaves adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Small Plant Study: a Burdock, Delicate Tufts of Grass at Left
artworks.description: The image features large, intricately detailed leaves dominating the scene. The color palette consists of shades of black, white, and grey, suggesting an etching or illustration. In the foreground, the expansive leaves spread outward and overlap each other, with some curling at the edges. In the background, more leaves fill the upper portion, extending toward the top as they cascade over one another. A tree or bush with fine, intricate details can be seen on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: A Thicket; a Gnarled Willow Tree at Left, a Thicket of Vegetation at Right
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of lush vegetation with intricate details. A gnarled tree with interwoven branches and cascading leaves dominates the left side of the scene. The textured bark and layered foliage are depicted with fine brushstrokes. In the middle, the horizon is indistinct behind dense vegetation. The right side features large leaves, grasses, and flowering plants with varied patterns and shading. The monochromatic palette uses blacks, whites, and greys to highlight details and textures, creating a rich natural scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Nudes Boarding a Boat
artworks.dimensions: plate: 41.1 x 36.4 cm (16 3/16 x 14 5/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: The image depicts a lush, wooded area with intricately detailed trees dominating the mid to high portion of the composition. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage. The style of brushstrokes resembles an etching, creating detailed textures and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, with variations of browns and grays. Human figures are seen beside a small boat in the underbrush, providing a focal point. In the distance, more trees are visible, blending into a dense forest background.

artworks.title: An Offering to Pan
artworks.description: This is an image of a fantastical forest scene. The central focus is a large, gnarled tree surrounded by dense foliage that creates a lush environment. Two statuesque figures are present near the tree, one seated and the other standing while playing a musical instrument. The scene features intricate details of natural elements such as leaves and branches, with a partially cloudy sky in the background. The image is meticulously composed with a variety of textures, bringing the mystical environment to life.

artworks.title: Bathing Maiden
artworks.description: The image shows a lush, densely vegetated landscape with a tree in the foreground, finely detailed in texture. In the center-left, a nude figure stands with their back to the viewer, surrounded by various foliage. The horizon is not distinct, and the scene is filled with greenery. The engraving features intricate line work, creating a texture-rich depiction of natural elements. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray to highlight the details of the surroundings.

artworks.title: Straw-Thatched Hut with Landscape and Figures
artworks.description: The image shows a thatched-roof cottage surrounded by trees. The dense canopy obscures the horizon. The drawing style is detailed, using fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The scene is in black and white. Three figures are in front of the cottage, with detailed clothing and gestures. The composition balances the natural and human elements.

artworks.title: The Damned
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 41.1 x 32.3 cm (16 3/16 x 12 11/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple nude figures in a chaotic scene. The composition shows figures in dynamic poses against a stormy background. One figure appears to be carrying or dragging another, while various limbs and torsos are intertwined. Some figures reach upwards with outstretched arms. Dark clouds and hints of lightning add to the intense atmosphere. The overall tone is dark and foreboding, evoking a sense of struggle or battle.
